description: Header file defining classes and structures for managing QUIC stream priorities, including HTTP and WebTransport priorities, with serialization and parsing functions.

classes.name: HttpStreamPriority
classes.description: Represents HTTP priorities with urgency and incremental flags, as per RFC 9218.

classes.name: WebTransportStreamPriority
classes.description: Represents WebTransport stream priorities, including stream type and send order.

classes.name: QuicStreamPriority
classes.description: A wrapper class that can hold either HTTP or WebTransport stream priorities for scheduling.

methods.name: SerializePriorityFieldValue
methods.description: Serializes an HttpStreamPriority into a string for PRIORITY_UPDATE frames.

methods.name: ParsePriorityFieldValue
methods.description: Parses a string from a PRIORITY_UPDATE frame into an HttpStreamPriority object.
